description: Use for: understanding page structure cheaply and deterministically — returns the accessibility tree (roles, names, states) as compact YAML instead of pixels or raw HTML. This is the lowest-token way to decide what to click or fill next. Don't use when: you need visual layout or images — use browser_screenshot. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base.

session_id.description: Session ID. Reuse the same ID to keep cookies, login state and page position across calls; a new ID starts a fresh browser.

name: browser_snapshot
title: Accessibility snapshot of the current page
